data.gender_notes: Bharathi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bharathi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bharatha' which means 'bringer of joy'. It is also associated with the Goddess Saraswati, the Hindu deity of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning. The name Bharathi carries the meaning “Bringer of Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Bharathi usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bharathi is a name that embodies the spiritual qualities of joy, wisdom, and creativity. It is believed to bring happiness and blessings to those who bear this name.
